Name: Bees Plus
Author: omena007
Description:
I thought honey and bees were quite underutilised in the game (there's not even a recipe with honey!) so here's a small extension.

This mod adds beeswax as an additional rare item to obtain from the bee houses. Beeswax can be used to craft items on a wax station that is unlocked by a quest. Three cooking recipes using honey have also been added to your cookbook. Honey Balm is a healing item.

[list]
[*]3 cooking recipes
[*]1 craftable machine Wax Station with 3 products
[*]2 quests and letters
[/list][b][img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/728830372155f8be38f0691e17ae85ec/62014660f4cf50c6-d6/s100x200/86e32f71f875e0f0bde6ada630786b635be0063f.png[/img]
[color=#fff2cc][size=4]Beeswax Products:
[/size][/color][/b][list]
[*][color=#fff2cc]Soap (add oil for basic, flowers for scented)[/color]
[*][color=#fff2cc]Candles (optional, add yarn from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8515]my Alpaca mod[/url]﻿)[/color]
[*][color=#fff2cc]Honey Balm (add honey)[/color]
[/list][color=#fff2cc][img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/728830372155f8be38f0691e17ae85ec/62014660f4cf50c6-d6/s100x200/86e32f71f875e0f0bde6ada630786b635be0063f.png[/img]
[size=4][b]Honey Recipes:[/b] [/size]
[/color][list]
[*][color=#fff2cc]Honey Poached Peaches[/color]
[*][color=#fff2cc]Honey Cake[/color]
[*][color=#fff2cc][color=#fff2cc]Honeyed[/color] Hasselback Carrots[/color]
[/list][img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/728830372155f8be38f0691e17ae85ec/62014660f4cf50c6-d6/s100x200/86e32f71f875e0f0bde6ada630786b635be0063f.png[/img]
[b][color=#fff2cc][size=4]Flying Bees (optional):[/size][/color]
[/b]
[color=#fff2cc]If you want my bees to fly over your farm you need to install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1255]Custom Critters[/url] ([url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/post-170430]unofficial update for 1.6.9[/url]) and drop my "CustomCritters" folder to your Mods root folder.
If you are using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10996]Better Beehouses[/url] and you want to use my bee sprites you can do the same as above and let my bees.png overwrite the original.[/color]

[b][size=4]Unlocking conditions:[/size][/b]

[spoiler]

Emily's quest is unlocked day after you have shipped beeswax.

Robin's quest is unlocked day after you have shipped honey.

Wax Station: finishing quest from Emily

Honey Poached Peaches: finishing quest from Robin

Honey Cake: Farming level 3

Honeyed Hasselback Carrots: sold at Saloon

[/spoiler]

There's also a config option for dark and light colored stations.

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/d2d43c832c3088acc48d38ae98dc0717/62014660f4cf50c6-29/s250x400/1690946730141d9579dcbc27b36e6c5d5bf3e203.png[/img]
This mod edits the vanilla bee houses so mods that make the similar edit might conflict. Flowers from other mods are compatible by default if they have context tag "flower_item" which is used in vanilla game code for all flowers except daffodil and dandelion (they are marked as forage).

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7842]Mail services mod[/url] [color=#d5a6bd]Uncertain?[/color] I've got a report that you are not able to get quest rewards if you use mail services to complete my quests.
